title: The network dashboard lies
story: An attacker alters management telemetry on emulated satellite links to display false health metrics while emergency calls fail.

everyday_impact.what: emergency calls fail while dashboard indicates normal health

human_decisions: Commander trusts independent user-plane telemetry over spoofed management dashboard.
Commander resolves playbook conflict by sequencing PB-01 credential isolation before PB-06 failover.
Commander approves PB-10 emergency notification drafted by Gap Analyst.

objective.what: Tower CHN-03 fails over from compromised telemetry satellite path to verified domestic microwave route.
proof: independent user-plane telemetry verifies call completion

schedule.what: Attacker falsifies management plane health metrics.
M1 detects mismatch between synthetic dashboard telemetry and actual traffic loss.
M3 confirms management-plane intrusion manipulating reported link state.
Gap Analyst audits binding satellite management security baselines.
Mobile operator proposes primary candidate failover path A.
Gap Analyst audits route integrity verification duties before failover.
Gap Analyst audits downstream warning requirements under manipulated telemetry conditions.
Satellite operator proposes PB-05 while mobile operator proposes PB-06 on tower CHN-03.
Commander resolves conflict by sequencing PB-01 first, leaves PB-05 unexecuted, and approves PB-10.
Mobile operator fails over tower CHN-03 to verified domestic path B.
Independent user plane telemetry confirms 112 emergency calls restored.
